clarification.preciseScope: The candidate rejects solo publication when the facade readMembersMeta promise rejects. The finite negative test injects a throwing/rejected readMembersMeta implementation; this proves only that rejection branch remains unknown.
clarification.canonicalReader: Main composition calls TeamMembersMetaStore.getMembers. Its existing getMeta returns null for absent metadata, FileReadTimeoutError, malformed JSON/shape and certain invalid file conditions. getMembers then normalizes null to []; other I/O errors propagate as rejected promises. These behaviors are unchanged.
clarification.notClaimed: No new strict validation of every absent/malformed/timed-out canonical metadata condition, and no fail-closed guarantee for errors already normalized to an empty array by the existing reader.
clarification.authorityUnchanged: The new solo path separately requires captured live POSIX custody, exact child/run/session/tracked owner and explicit empty in-memory expected/all/mixed/request rosters. Canonical metadata does not create those authorities.
